title: Specialist Semantic Validation Output Schema v3.2
description: Thirteen Specialist semantic failure flags. Controls use their frozen validator and schema. Runtime computes passed and failedCriteria.

notGrounded.description: Unsupported public factual assertion or incomplete source support.

nonNeutral.description: Facilitator preference, weighting or pressure toward an option.

roleMisaligned.description: Incompatible Specialist function, misrouted control role, boundary violation, or disclosure of internal role/operation/plan/assessor/prompt/selection information. Ordinary reasoning language is not internal disclosure.

inventedInformation.description: Fact or asserted relationship absent from authorised public sources.

recommendationDetected.description: Facilitator recommendation, ranking, scoring, vote or declared final answer.

unsupportedInformationDetected.description: Task or participant assertion unavailable in authorised public sources.

unsupportedConsensusClaim.description: Group agreement asserted beyond the visible participant evidence.

optionSteering.description: Implicit option pressure through selective framing or leading wording.

requiredReasoningActMissing.description: Missing or non-passed preflight, non-executable plan, unsupported/already-addressed target, or missing exact assigned operation. Does not permit invented completion. For Synthesiser, any omitted or distorted relevant public information in the required scope fails the assigned operation.

unanswerable.description: No substantive, answerable closing question, more than one substantive question, or a question with unsupported premises. Every Specialist role requires exactly one closing question.

hiddenInformationInference.description: Inference or disclosure of undisclosed profile, knowledge ownership or motives.

repetition.description: Same target/operation without changed need, or redundant work already completed in supplied public context.

length.description: Expander/Challenger exceed 50 English words. Synthesiser has no hard word cap; retain all required public information and minimise repetition/filler.
